**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind chmod to the blob that was validated**

When `R300_R2VB_TELEMETRY_RETAIN` names a directory writable by another user or process, the final pathname can be replaced after `file_matches_blob()` closes its descriptor. This separate `open(path, O_RDONLY)` follows symlinks, so an attacker can swap in a symlink before the open and make the Mesa process apply its effective publication mode—commonly 0644—to an unrelated file it owns. Open with `O_NOFOLLOW`, validate the blob through that same descriptor, and apply `fchmod` to it without reopening by pathname.
